failures: col 10003 'Table 34 indicates the victims of rape classified under three age groups viz., below 16 years, between 16 to 30 years and above 30 years. The age group between 16 to 30 years accounted for 58.7% of the total victims of rape. The All India pattern is not reflected in different States and Union Territories. However, the percentage in this group is consistently higher than the other two groups in all the States except Orissa, Tamil Nadu and Delhi where it is either equal or slightly more than the number in the group of 16 to 30 years.': printed 2487, sum 4974
